title: Jim Semivan's bedroom encounter with beings and a guardian
summary: Grant Cameron tells of Jim Semivan's bedroom encounter with beings and a guardian, about unspecified at United States (no place named), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: "I was standing there with my wife and these beings were there and there was somebody behind me.

plain: A UFO researcher named Grant Cameron relays an experience of Jim Semivan, a man who worked at the CIA, the US spy agency, in his own bedroom. Cameron quotes Semivan saying he was standing there with his wife, some beings were in the room, and someone was standing behind him, a figure the story calls a guardian. If true, it means a former intelligence officer personally met non-human visitors.
